method: Every stored unclear term of the reader-test records was scored against the fixed rubric, with no new review. Terms whose quoted words are exempt words or counters were matched by lib/reader-first-rubric.ts, as check:reader-first matches them. A mark, kicker, self-label or credit was exempted only where the stored answer text, read against the frame's source at the record's commit where noted, shows that it is an item the rubric names; every other term still counts. A record would pass when its answer is yes and no term counts. The records and their verdicts are unchanged and stay for the convergence round.
